notablePrerequisites:
Two additional nonartifact green creature cards in hand that can be cast for {G}.
You have at least 3 life.
description:
Cast a green creature spell by paying 2 life.
Defiler of Vigor and Silverback Elder each trigger.
Resolve the Silverback Elder trigger, gaining 4 life.
Resolve the Defiler of Vigor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the creature spell.
Cloudstone Curio triggers; if the other creature is on the battlefield, return it to your hand; otherwise choose not to return anything.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat any number of times again, this time choosing either of Silverback Elder's other modes.
